title: NOTAM / TFR
description: A single FAA Notice to Air Missions. Variant 'text' is a NOTAM Search result with the raw NOTAM text in monospace (domestic/FDC format, upper case, '..' separators). Variant 'tfr' is the TFR detail page for a Temporary Flight Restriction (14 CFR 99.7 special security instructions over a stadium, 91.137 disaster/hazard area, 91.145 airshow), with the tfr block filled. Places and venues are simulated; the FAA and its facility identifiers stay real.

notamNumber.description: NOTAM number as published (FDC NOTAMs are M/NNNN)

facility.description: Issuing facility / accountability (ARTCC or airport identifier, or FDC)

location.description: Location the NOTAM applies to, upper case, as in the NOTAM

text.description: Full raw NOTAM text, upper case, as the FAA publishes it (keep newlines out; use '..' between parts)
examples: !FDC 6/4012 ZOB OH..AIRSPACE LAKEPORT, OH..TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 3NM RADIUS OF 412823N0814252W SFC-2999FT AGL EFFECTIVE 2610261600 UTC UNTIL 2610262300 UTC.
Stadium event — Lakeport Ironclads home game, Lakeport Stadium

restrictions.description: Operating restrictions and requirements, one per line
examples: No UAS operations without an FAA waiver or authorization.
